name: sterlingrx-advisors
description: Pharmacy business intelligence. One Node process serves the Express API and the React site.

scripts.//build: Installs the client toolchain first, so a fresh clone can build without a separate step. Run on your own machine, not the host -- a Vite build needs more memory than shared hosting allows.
scripts.build: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.build:web: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build

//dependencies: Everything the server needs at runtime, listed HERE rather than only in server/package.json. cPanel runs npm install from inside its virtualenv directory, not the app root, so a nested 'npm --prefix server install' resolves the prefix against the wrong place and fails with ENOENT. One manifest at the root is the only layout that survives that. Node still resolves these from server/*.js by walking up to the root node_modules. server/tests/deps.test.js fails the build if the two manifests drift apart.
